bluetooth_confirm.title: Indoor bike
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant won't connect to it until you turn on its session switch, so apps like Kinomap and Zwift keep working as before.

user.title: Indoor bike
user.description: Pick the bike. Only bikes Home Assistant can hear right now are listed, so pedal for a moment first to wake the console. Setting up doesn't connect to it.

abort.already_configured: This bike is already set up.
abort.not_a_bike: This fitness machine isn't an indoor bike.
abort.no_bikes: No indoor bikes can be heard right now. Pedal for a moment to wake the console, then try again.

init.title: Resistance
init.description: Consoles read the resistance command in one of two ways, and nothing the bike reports says which. If setting a level in Home Assistant lands on a different level on the console, try the other one.

data_description.resistance_scale: Automatic picks spread for consoles with more than 25 levels.

options.tenths: Tenths of a level (the FTMS standard)
